וּמטטרו"ן אִיהוּ אָרוֹן, גּוּפָא לְאוֹרַיְיתָא דְבִכְתָב דְּאִיהוּ עַמּוּדָא דְאֶמְצָעִיתָא, וְאִיהוּ שֻׁלְחָן, פָּתוֹרָא דִשְׁכִינְתָּא דְאִיהִי לֵ"ב, דְּאִתְּמַר בֵּיהּ לֵ"ב מֵבִין, וְאִיהוּ לִשְׂמָאלָא, וּבְגִין דָּא אָמְרוּ מָארֵי מַתְנִיתִין שֻׁלְחָן בַּצָּפוֹן.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 14b:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/14b:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/14b:7)


וְאִיהוּ מְנוֹרָה נוּר דָּלִיק מִסִּטְרָא דִשְׁכִינְתָּא, דְאִתְּמַר בָּהּ נֵר יהו"ה, וְצָרִיךְ לְמֶהֱוֵי לִימִינָא לְקַבָּלָא מִשְׁחָא, וּבְגִין דָּא מְנוֹרָה בְּדָרוֹם, דָּא אִיהוּ מָאנָא לְקַבָּלָא פְּתִילָה וּמִשְׁחָא וּנְהוֹרָא, פְּתִילָה שְׁכִינָה, מִשְׁחָא דִילָהּ צַדִּיק שֶׁמֶן כָּתִית, נְהוֹרָא דִילָהּ עַמּוּדָא דְאֶמְצָעִיתָא, כְּגַוְונָא דָא נַפְשָׁא דְאִיהִי שִׁתּוּפָא דְגוּפָא אִיהִי פְּתִילָה, רוּחַ דָּא מִשְׁחָא, נְהוֹרָא דָא נִשְׁמָתָא, מָאנָא דָא גוּפָא, אִיהוּ עִִבֶד, וְאִיהוּ רֶכֶב לִתְלַת סִטְרִין אִלֵּין, דְּאִינוּן קִיטוּרָא דְיִחוּדָא חֲדָא, דְאִינוּן נֵר יהו"ה נִשְׁמַת אָדָם (משלי כ כז).


###### Tikkunei Zohar 14b:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/14b:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/14b:8)


וְהַאי עִִבֶד אִיהוּ כִּנּוּיָא לְכָל שְׁמָהָן, שִׁנּוּי לְכָל שְׁמָהָן, וּבֵיהּ מַרְכִּיבִין כָּל אִלָּנִין עִלָּאִין מִסִּטְרָא דְטוֹב, מֶרְכָּבוֹת דְּסִטְרָא דְרַע, עֲלַיְיהוּ אִתְּמַר וְלֹא בָּעֲרָיוֹת בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה, מַאי עֲרָיוֹת סמא"ל וְנָחָשׁ, לָא צָרִיךְ לְמֶהֱוִי בִשְׁלֹשָׁה, דְאִינוּן מַשְׁחִי"ת אַ"ף וְחֵימָ"ה, לְמֶהֱוֵי תְּלִיתָאָה בֵּינַיְיהוּ, דְּלָא מִתְקַשְּׁרִין בְּהוֹן, אֶלָּא דִיְהוֹן תַּרְוַיְיהוּ



## Daf 15a

###### Tikkunei Zohar 15a:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:1)


בְּפִרוּדָא, וּבְגִין דָּא אֵין דּוֹרְשִׁין בָּעֲרָיוֹת בִּתְלָתָא, וְעוֹבָדָא דִבְּרֵאשִׁית בְּהִפּוּכָא, אֵין דּוֹרְשִׁין בְּמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית בִּשְׁנַיִם, דְּלָא יַעַבְדוּן פִּרוּדָא, אֶלָּא בְּיָחִיד דְּאִיהוּ יִחוּדָא חָד, וּבְגִין דָּא לֹא יֹאכַל אָדָם תְּרֵי, וְלֹא יִשְׁתֶּה תְּרֵי.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 15a:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:2)


וְלֹא בְמֶרְכָּבָה בְיָחִיד, בְּגִין דְּיָחִיד לֵית לֵיהּ שִׁתּוּף דְּאִיהוּ מטטרו"ן, כְּגַוְונָא דְנִשְׁמָתָא דְלֵית לָהּ שִׁתּוּף בְּגוּפָא, וְאַמַּאי אָמַר אֶלָּא אִם כֵּן הָיָה חָכָם וּמֵבִין מִדַּעִִתּוֹ, הָכָא מַשְׁמַע דְּאִית לֵיהּ מֶרְכָּבָה לְעִילָא לְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא, דְאִיהוּ מְלָאכָה דִילֵיהּ, וּמַאי אִיהִי הַהִיא דְאִיהִי כְלִילָא מֵחָכְמָה וּבִינָה וָדַעַת, דְּאִינוּן יה"ו, מְלָאכָה דִתְלַת אַתְוָון אִיהִי ה' שְׁכִינְתָּא תַּתָּאָה, שְׁלִימוּ דִתְלַת אַתְוָון, עֲלָהּ אִתְּמַר (שמות לט לב) וַתֵּכֶל כָּל עֲבוֹדַת מִשְׁכַּן וגו', וְאִיהִי ה' דְּיוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי, וּבְגִין דָּא אַף עַל גַּב דְּאַמְרִינָן אֵין דּוֹרְשִׁין בְּמֶרְכָּבָה בְּיָחִיד, חָזַר וְאָמַר אֶלָּא אִם כֵּן הָיָה חָכָם וּמֵבִין מִדַּעִִתּוֹ, דְּוַדַּאי בְּאִלֵּין תְּלַת דּוֹרְשִׁין בְּמֶרְכָּבָה בְּיָחִיד, וּבְלָא אִלֵּין תְּלַת לַאו אִיהוּ יִחוּדָא דִילֵיהּ, וְדָא אִיהוּ רָזָא, דְאִיהוּ קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעִילָא חַד בִּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 15a:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:3)


וְכַד אִיהוּ לְתַתָּא בְּמטטרו"ן בְּלָא שְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ, אִשְׁתַּנִּי בֵיהּ, וּבְגִין דָּא אָמַר אֱלִישָׁע אַחֵר, שֶׁמָּא חַס וְשָׁלוֹם שְׁתֵּי רְשׁוּיוֹת יֵשׁ, וּבְגִין דָּא אָמַר אַל תְּמִירֵנִי בוֹ, כִּי שְׁמִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ, בְּגִין דְמטטרו"ן אִיהוּ שֵׁנִי לַמֶּלֶךְ, וְכַד אִיהִי שְׁכִינְתָּא בְּלָא בַּעִִלָהּ, אִתְקְרֵי הַאי מַלְאָךְ מִשְׁנֶה לָהּ, וְאִשְׁתְּנִיאַת דְּלָא אִשְׁתְּמוֹדְעִין בָּהּ חֲיָילִין, וּמַה דְּאִיהִי מַטְרוֹנִיתָא, וּבְמַאי הִיא מִתְכַסְּיָא, בְּהַהִיא דְאִתְקְרִיאַת אָמָה.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 15a:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:4)


וְדָא הוּא דְאָמַר קְרָא (שמות כא יג) וְכִי יִמְכּוֹר אִישׁ אֶת בִּתּוֹ לְאָמָה, אִישׁ דָּא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא, בִּתּוֹ דָּא שְׁכִינְתָּא, לְאָמָה בַּת זוּגֵיהּ דְמטטרו"ן, דְּאִיהִי מיטטרו"ן בְּתוֹסֶפֶת יוּ"ד, דְּשִׁפְחָה בִישָׁא הִיא אָמָה דְעִרֶב רַב, וּבְגִין דְּהַהִיא שִׁפְחָה בִּישָׁא וּבְנָהָא לָא אִשְׁתְּמוֹדְעִין בָּהּ, אִיהִי מִתְכַסְּיָא בְעַבְדָּא דִילָהּ, כְּנִשְׁמָתָא בְּגוּפָא.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 15a:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:5)


וּבְגָלוּתָא קַדְמָאָה דְּלָא חָזְרַת לְמַלְכוּתָהָא בְּרַתָּא דְמַלְכָּא, וְלָא נָפְקַת מֵהַהוּא גוּפָא, לָא נָפְקַת חָפְשִׁית, וּבְגִינָהָא אִתְּמַר בְּהוֹן, עֲבָדִים הָיִינוּ לְפַרְעֹה בְּמִצְרָיִם בְּגִין דַּהֲווֹ תְּחוֹת רְשׁוּ דְּהַהוּא עִִבֶד, וּבְגִין דָּא אָמַר פַּרְעֹה בְּהַאי אֲתַר לֹא יָדַעִִתִּי אֶת יְיָ', וְגַם אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא אֲשַׁלֵּחַ (שמות ה ב), וּבְגִין דָּא נָפְקוּ בִּמְנוּסָה, כְּעַבְדָּא דְלֵית לֵיהּ כְּתַב חֵירוּ וּבָרַח מֵרִבּוֹנֵיהּ.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 15a:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:6)


אֲבָל בְּפוּרְקָנָא בַּתְרָאָה לָא נָפְקַת בְּרַתָּא, בְּהַאי עַבְדָּא כְּשִׁפְחָה, אֶלָּא בְּקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא, בְּגִין דְּאוֹרַיְיתָא דְּאִיהִי חֵירוּ, אִיהִי עִמָּהּ בְּגָלוּתָא בַּתְרָאָה, דְּאִיהִי חֵירוּ דִּילָהּ, מַה דְּלָא הֲוָה הָכִי בְגָלוּתָא קַדְמָאָה, דְלָא הֲוָה לָהּ וְלִבְנָהָא אוֹרַיְיתָא דְּאִיהִי חֵירוּ, דְאוֹרַיְיתָא וַדַּאי אִיהִי חֵירוּ, בְּמַלְכוּתָא דִילָהּ בִּיקָרָא דִילָהּ, הֲדָא הוּא דִכְתִיב (משלי ג טו) יְקָרָה הִיא מִפְּנִינִים, וּבְגִין דָּא לֹא תֵצֵא כְּצֵאת הָעֲבָדִים (שמות כו ז), וְדָא הוּא דְאָמַר כִּי לֹא בְחִפָּזוֹן תֵּצֵאוּ, וּבִמְנוּסָה לֹא תֵלֵכוּן, כִּי הוֹלֵךְ לִפְנֵיכֶם יהו"ה (ישעיה נב יב), יהו"ה וַדַּאי אִיהוּ יוֹקִים לוֹן מֵעַפְרָא, וְאִיהוּ נָהִיר עַל אַנְפּוֹי דְּיִשְׂרָאֵל, וּבֵיהּ אִשְׁתְּמוֹדְעִין כָּל עָלְמִין דְּאִינוּן (שם סא ט) זֶרַע בֵּרַךְ יהו"ה.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 15a:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:7)


וְאִתְפַּשַּׁט קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא מִכָּל כִּנּוּיָין, וּמֶרְכָּבוֹת דְמטטרו"ן, דְּאִינוּן כוז"ו במוכס"ז כוז"ו, מצפ"ץ, וְאִתְּמַר בֵּיהּ (ישעיה ל ב) וְלֹא יִכָּנֵף עוֹד מוֹרֶיךָ, וְהָיוּ עִינֶיךָ רוֹאוֹת אֶת מוֹרֶיךָ, בְּהַהוּא זִמְנָא, כִּי עַיִן בְּעַיִן יִרְאוּ בְּשׁוּב יהו"ה צִיּוֹן (שם לב כ), וְאִתְפַּשַּׁט מִמֶּרְכָּבוֹת דִּלְתַתָּא, וְאִתְלַבַּשׁ בְּמֶרְכָּבָה דִילֵיהּ דְּאִיהִי אדנ"י, שֵׁם הַמֶּרְכָּבָה דָא יהו"ה, כִּנּוּ"י דָא אֱלֹהִי"ם, דְּסָלִיק לְחֻשְׁבַּן אהי"ה אדנ"י, וְאִיהוּ כִנּוּ"י דִתְרֵין שְׁמָהָן אִלֵּין וּבֵיהּ אִתְכַּסְיָין.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 15a:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/15a:8)


אהי"ה אִיהוּ יה"ו, ו' דְּאִיהוּ כְּלִילָא דְשִׁית סִטְרִין, דִּבְהוֹן חָתִים שִׁית סִטְרִין, וְאִינוּן יה"ו הו"י וה"י וי"ה הי"ו יו"ה, יה"ו נָטִיל לֵיהּ יְמִינָא דְאִיהוּ חֶסֶ"ד, וְחָתִים בֵּיהּ לְחָכְמְתָא, וּבֵיהּ הָרוֹצֶה לְהַחְכִּים יַדְרִים.



## Daf 15b

הו"י נָטִיל לִשְׂמָאלָא דְאִיהוּ גְבוּרָה, וְחָתִים בֵּיהּ לְעוּתְרָא, וּבֵיהּ הָרוֹצֶה לְהַעֲשִׁיר יַצְפִּין, וה"י פָּנָה לְמִזְרָח, וְנָטִיל לֵיהּ עַמּוּדָא דְאֶמְצָעִיתָא, וְחָתִים בֵּיהּ בָּנֵי, וי"ה נָטִיל לֵיהּ יַרְכָא יְמִינָא, וְאִסְתַּכַּל בֵּיהּ לְעִילָא, וְחָתִים בֵּיהּ חַיֵּי, הי"ו נָטִיל לֵיהּ יַרְכָא שְׂמָאלָא, וְאִסְתַּכַּל לְתַתָּא, וְחָתִים בֵּיהּ מְזוֹנֵי, אִסְתַּכַּל לְעִילָא לְגַבֵּי חָכְמָה, וְאִתְקַשַּׁר בְּיַרְכָא יְמִינָא, וְחָתִים בֵּיהּ חַיִּים, בְּגִין דְּחָכְמָה עֲלֵיהּ אִתְּמַר (קהלת ז ב) וְהַחָכְמָה תְּחַיֶּה בְעָלֶיהָ, אִסְתַּכַּל לְעִילָא לְגַבֵּי אִימָּא עִלָּאָה, וְאִתְקַשַּׁר בְּיַרְכָא שְׂמָאלָא, וְחָתִים בֵּיהּ מְזוֹנֵי, יו"ה פָּנָה לְמַעֲרָב בְּצַדִּיק, דְּאִיהוּ עִרוּב, דְּתַמָּן מִתְעָרְבִין כָּל חֲיָילִין, וְאִתְכְּלִיל בְּחַ"י אַתְוָון, דְּאִינוּן יה"ו הו"י וי"ה הי"ו יו"ה וה"י, אִלֵּין אִינוּן י"ח אַתְוָון, דִּבְהוֹן חַ"י עָלְמִין אִתְקְרֵי, וְצַדִּיק בְּהוֹן אִתְקְרֵי חַ"י עָלְמִין.

דָּבָר אַחֵר וְהַמַּשְׂכִּילִים יַזְהִירוּ, אִלֵין אִינוּן אַתְוָון, דַּהֲוָה לוֹן שֵׂכֶל לְאַעָלָא קֳדָם מַלְכָּא, כָּל חַד עַל תִּקּוּנוֹי, מִסִּטְרָא דִגְבוּרָה עָאלוּ כֻּלְּהוּ לְמַפְרֵעַ, בְּגִין דְּאִיהִי דְרוֹעָא שְׂמָאלָא תִּשְׁרִ"י, וְדָא אִיהוּ בְּרֵאשִׁי"ת בָּ"א תִּשְׁרִ"י, בְּגִין דִּבְמִדַּת הַדִּין אִתְבְּרֵי עָלְמָא, וּבְגִין דָּא עָאלוּ לְמַפְרֵעַ, וְהָא אוּקְמוּהוּ דְּבִימִינָא אִתְבְּרֵי עָלְמָא, וּבֵיהּ עָאלוּ אַתְוָון כְּסִדְרָן, וְרָזָא דְמִלָּה אָמַרְתִּי עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה (תהלים פט ג), וּבְגִין דָּא כַּד עָאלוּ אַתְוָון לְמַפְרֵעַ, וּמִנַּיְיהוּ כְּסִדְרָן, לָא בָּעָא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְמִבְרֵי בְּהוֹן עָלְמָא, עַד דְּשִׁתֵּף לוֹן בִּימִינָא וּשְׂמָאלָא וּבָרָא בְּהוֹן עָלְמָא.

אלין אינון ר' שמעון בן יוחאי וחבריו 
ר' אלעזר בריה 
ור' אבא 
ור' יוסי ור' חייא ור' יצחק 
ושאר חבריא 
דאזדהרו זהירו (נ"א דמזהירין) לעילא 
כזהר הרקיע.


These are Rabbi Shim’on ben Yoḥai and his companions: 
Rabbi El’azar his son, 
and Rabbi Abba, 
and Rabbi Yosse, and Rabbi Ḥiya, and Rabbi Yitzḥaq, 
and the rest of the companions, 
who radiate radiance [Var. who are radiating] above, 
... *like the radiance of the firmament*.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:5)


מאי כזהר. 
אלא כד עבדו האי חבורא 
אסתכמו עליה לעילא 
וקראו ליה ספר הזהר.


What is meant by ‘*like the radiance*’? 
But when they made this composition, 
it was agreed to on high, 
and they called it *The Book of Radiance*¹.

footnotes:
¹ Sepher ha-Zohar


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:6)


ומצדיקי הרבים ביה. 
יהון נפישין


(ibid.) ... *and those who bring the many to righteousness* – through it, 
may they be many!


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:7)


כככבים לעולם ועד דלא אתחשיך נהורא דלהון 
לעלם ולעלמי עלמין.


(ibid.) ... *like the stars forever* – that their light never be darkened, 
for ever and ever and ever.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:8)


בההוא זמנא 
דאתחבר האי חבורא 
*רשותא אתיהיב לאליהו לאסכמא עמהון ביה. 
ולכל מארי מתיבתא דלעילא ותתא. 
וכל חיילין דמלאכין עלאין ונשמתין עלאין 
למהוי עמהון באסכמותא ורעותא כחדא.


At that time, 
when this composition was composed, 
permission was granted to Elijah to acquiesce with them in it, 
and to all the Masters of the Academy above and below, 
and all the forces of the higher angels, and higher souls, 
to be with them in agreement and friendship as one.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:9)


פתח אליהו ואמר 
רבון עלמין 
דאנת הוא חד 
ולא בחשבן.


Elijah opened began, and he said: 
Master of the Worlds! 
For You are He that is One 
– but not in number.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:10)


אנת הוא עלאה על כל עלאין 
סתימא על כל סתימין. 
לית מחשבה תפיסא בך כלל.


You are high above all the high-ones, 
hidden, beyond all that is hidden, 
no thought apprehends You at all.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:11)


אנת הוא דאפיקת עשר תקונין. 
וקרינן לון עשר ספירן. 
לאנהגא בהון עלמין סתימין דלא אתגליין. 
ועלמין דאתגליין. 
ובהון אתכסיאת (נ"א אתכסייא) 
מבני נשא.


You are He that has produced ten ‘constructs’¹ 
– and we call them ‘the ten *sephirot*’² – 
with which to direct hidden worlds that are not revealed, 
and worlds that are revealed. 
And in them You are concealed [Var. it is concealed], 
from humans.

¹ tiqqunin

###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:12)


ואנת הוא דקשיר לון 
ומיחד לון. 
ובגין דאנת מלגאו. 
כל מאן דאפריש חד מן חבריה מאלין עשר. 
אתחשיב ליה כאלו אפריש בך.


And You are He that binds them, 
and unites them, 
and, because You are within them, 
anyone who separates one from its companion, of these ten, 
is considered as though he had caused separation in You.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:13)


ואלין עשר ספירן. 
אינון אזלין כסדרן. 
חד אריך וחד קצר וחד בינוני


And these ten *sephirot*, 
they are going according to their order: 
one long, and one short, and one intermediate.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:14)


ואנת הוא דאנהיג לון. 
ולית מאן דאנהיג לך 
לא לעילא ולא לתתא 
ולא מכל סטרא.


And You are He that directs them, 
and there is none who direct You, 
– not above, and not below, 
and not from any side.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:15)


*לבושין תקינת לון 
דמנייהו פרחין נשמתין לבני (נ"א דבני) נשא 
וכמה גופין תקינת לון 
דאתקריאו גופא 
לגבי לבושין דמכסיין עליהון.


Garments have You fixed for them, 
from which fly-forth souls for [Var. of] human beings. 
And many bodies You have fixed for them, 
– which are called ‘body’, 
relative to the ‘garments’ which cover them.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:16)


ואתקריאו בתקונא דא. 
חסד דרועא ימינא. 
גבורה דרועא שמאלא. 
תפארת גופא. 
נצח והוד תרין שוקין. 
ויסוד סיומא דגופא 
אות ברית קדש. 
מלכות פה. תורה שבע"פ קרינן ליה.


And they are called in this arrangement: 
Ḥesed – right arm, 
Gevurah – left arm, 
Tipheret – body, 
Netzaḥ and Hod – two thighs, 
and Yesod – end of the body, 
– sign of the holy covenant. 
Malkhut – ‘mouth’ – we call it ‘Oral Torah’.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:17)


מוחא חכמה 
איהו מחשבה מלגו. 
בינה לבא 
ובה הלב מבין. 
ועל אלין תרין כתיב 
*הנסתרות ליי' אלקינו.


The brain is Ḥokhmah, 
it is inner thought. 
Binah is the heart, 
and with it the heart understands. 
And upon these two it is written: 
(Deut. 29:28) *The hidden things are for* *Y”Y* *our God*....


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:18)


כתר עליון 
איהו כתר מלכות. 
ועליה *אתמר מגיד מראשית אחרית. 
ואיהו קרקפתא דתפלי 
(נ"א קרקפתא דלא מנח תפלי). 
*מלגו איהו יוד קא ואו קא 
דאיהו ארח אצילות.


Higher Keter, 
it is the ‘crown of sovereignty’, 
and upon it is stated: (Is. 46:10) *He* *tells the end from the beginning*... 
And it is ‘the skull of phylacteries’ 
[Var. ‘the skull that does not lay phylacteries’¹ ]. 
Inside it is YOD QE VAV QE², 
which is ‘the way of emanation’.

###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:19)


איהו שקיו דאילנא 
בדרועוי וענפוי (נ"א ואנפוי). 
כמיא דאשקי לאילנא 
ואתרבי בההוא שקיו.


It is the watering of the tree, 
with its arms and its branches, [Var. and its faces] 
like water, which irrigates a tree, 
and it grows through that watering.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:20)


**רבון** העולמים 
אנת הוא עלת העלות 
סבת הסבות 
דאשקי לאילנא בההוא נביעו.


**Master** of the worlds! 
You are ‘the Cause of causes’, 
the Reason of reasons, 
Who waters the tree – with that fountain!


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:21)


וההוא נביעו איהו כנשמתא לגופא 
דאיהו חיים לגופא. 
ובך 
לית דמיון ולית דיוקנא 
מכל מה דלגו ולבר.


And that fountain is like a soul to the body, 
which is the body’s life-force. 
And yet of You, 
there is no imagining, and there is no likeness, 
of anything that is inside or out.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17a:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17a:22)


ובראת שמיא וארעא. 
ואפיקת מנהון שמשא וסיהרא 
וככביא ומזלי 
ובארעא אלנין ודשאין 
וגנתא דעדן 
(ועשבין) וחיוון ועופין ונונין 
ובני נשא. 
לאשתמודעא בהון עלאין. 
ואיך יתנהגון בהון עלאין ותתאין. 
ואיך אשתמודעאן מעלאי ותתאי. 
ולית בך דידע כלל


And You created heaven and earth, 
and You produced from them the sun and the moon, 
and stars and constellations. 
And on the earth: trees, and grasses, 
and the Garden of Eden, 
[and herbs] and beasts, and birds, and fish, 
and people, 
so that higher-ones would be recognised through them, 
and how high-ones and low-ones are directed through them, 
and how they are recognised from higher and lower 
– and there is none that knows of You at all.



## Daf 17b

###### Tikkunei Zohar 17b:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:1)


ובר מינך לית יחידא (ס"א יחודא) 
בעלאי ותתאי. 
ואנת אשתמודע אדון על כלא.


And outside of You, there is no uniqueness [Var. unity] 
among the higher and the lower, 
and You are known as ‘Lord over All’.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17b:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:2)


וכל ספירן 
כל חד אית ליה שם ידיע. 
ובהון אתקריאו מלאכיא. 
ואנת לית לך שם ידיע. 
דאנת הוא ממלא כל שמהן. 
ואנת הוא שלימו דכלהו 
וכד אנת תסתלק מנהון 
אשתארו כלהו שמהן כגופא בלא נשמתא.


And all the *sephirot*, 
each one has its own name, 
and with them, angels are called. 
But You have no specific Name, 
for You are He that fills all Names, 
and You are the completeness of everything. 
And when You withdraw from them, 
all those names are left like a body without a soul.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17b:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:3)


אנת חכים 
ולאו בחכמה ידיעא. 
אנת הוא מבין 
ולא מבינה ידיעא. 
לית לך אתר ידיעא 
אלא לאשתמודעא תוקפך וחילך 
לבני נשא. 
ולאחזאה לון איך אתנהיג עלמא 
בדינא וברחמי 
דאינון צדק ומשפט 
כפום עובדיהון דבני נשא.


You are ‘wise’, 
but not with any specific ‘wisdom’. 
You are He that ‘understands’, 
but not from any specific ‘understanding’. 
You have no specific ‘place’, 
other than to make known Your strength and Your power 
to humans, 
and to show them how the world is governed, 
– through judgement and through mercy, 
which are ‘righteousness and justice’ – 
according to the deeds of people.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17b:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:4)


דין איהו גבורה. 
משפט עמודא דאמצעיתא. 
צדק מלכותא קדישא. 
מאזני צדק *****תרין סמכי קשוט. 
הין צדק אות ברית. 
כלא לאחזאה איך אתנהיג עלמא.


‘Judgement’ is Gevurah, 
Justice is ‘the Middle Pillar’¹, 
Righteousness² is ‘the holy kingdom’¹, 
(Lev. 19:36) *Scales of righteousness...*– ‘two pillars of truth’¹, 
... *the ‘hin’* *of righteousness...*– ‘sign of the covenant’¹. 
All are to show how the world is governed.

footnotes:
¹ Tipheret
² tzedeq
¹ Malkhut
¹ Netzaḥ-Hod
¹ Yesod


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17b:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:5)


אבל לאו דאית לך צדק ידיעא 
דאיהו דין. 
ולאו משפט ידיע' 
דאיהו רחמי 
ולאו מכל אלין מדות כלל.


But not that You have any specific righteousness – 
which is ‘judgement’, 
and no specific justice – 
which is ‘mercy’. 
And none of any of these attributes at all.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17b:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:6)


קום רבי שמעון 
ויתחדשון מלין על ידך 
דהא רשותא אית לך (נ"א אתיהיב לך) 
לגלאה רזין טמירין על ידך 
מה דלא אתייהיב רשו לגלאה לשום בר נש 
עד כען.


Rise Rabbi Shim’on! 
And may words be innovated by your hand! 
For behold you have permission [Var. it is given to you], 
to reveal hidden secrets by your hand, 
that for which permission to reveal was not given to any person, 
until now.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17b:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:7)


**קם** רבי שמעון 
פתח ואמר לך יי' 
הגדולה והגבורה וכו'


**Arose** Rabbi Shim’on. 
He opened and said: (1 Chron. 29:11) *To You,* *Y”Y, 
is the greatness* *and the might*... *etc*.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17b:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:8)


עלאין שמעו 
אינון דמיכין דחברון ורעיא מהימנא 
אתערו משנתכון


Hear O high-ones! 
Those sleepers of Hebron, and the Faithful Shepherd! 
Wake up from your slumber!


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17b:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:9)


הקיצו ורננו שוכני עפר 
אלין אינון צדיקיא 
דאינון מסטרא דההוא דאתמר בה 
אני ישנה ולבי ער 
ולאו אינון מתים 
ובגין דא אתמר בהון הקיצו ורננו וכו'


(Is. 26:19) ... *Wake up and rejoice! O dwellers of the dust*... 
These are the righteous-ones, 
who are from the aspect of whom it is stated: 
(Song. 5:2) *I am asleep, and my heart is awake*... 
And they are not dead. 
And thus, it is said of them: (Is. 26:19) ... *Wake up and rejoice... etc.*


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17b:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:10)


הקיצו ר"מ 
אתער אנת ואבהן 
לאתערותא דשכינתא 
דאיהי ישנה בגלותא. 
דעד כען צדיקיא כלהו דמיכין 
ושינתא בחוריהון.


Awake O Faithful Shepherd! 
Be aroused, you and the Patriarchs, 
for the arousal of the Shekhinah, 
Who is sleeping in exile, 
for until now the righteous have all been reposing, 
and slumber is in their nostrils.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17b:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:11)


מיד 
'יהיבת שכינת' (נ"א אתערון) תלת קלין 
לגבי ר"מ ויימא ליה 
קום רעיא מהימנא 
דהא עלך אתמר קול דודי דופק 
לגבאי בארבע אתוון דיליה.


Immediately, 
the Shekhinah gives [Var. there are aroused] three ‘voices’, 
towards the Faithful Shepherd, and says to him: 
‘Rise O Faithful Shepherd! 
For about you it is stated: (Song. 5:2) ... *the voice of my beloved is knocking*... 
towards Me – with His four letters.’


###### Tikkunei Zohar 17b:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:12)


ויימא בהון פתחי לי 
אחותי רעתי 
יונתי תמתי 
דהא תם עונך בת ציון 
לא יוסיף להגלותך.


And He shall say through them: ‘... *open-up for Me, 
My sister, My beloved, 
My dove, My‘completion’*¹...’ 
For behold: (Lam. 4:22) *Completed*¹ *is your sin, O daughter of Zion, 
He will not exile you again*...’

###### Tikkunei Zohar 17b:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/17b:13)


שראשי נמלא טל. 
מאי נמלא טל. 
אלא אמר קב"ה 
אנת חשיבא דמיומא דאתחרב בי מקדשא 
דעאלנא בביתא דילי 
ועאלנא בישובא. 
לאו הכי 
דלא אעלנא כל זמנא דאנת בגלותא.


(Song. 5:2) ... *for my head is full of dew*....¹ 
What is the meaning of *full of dew*? 
But the blessed Holy One said: 
‘Do you think that since the day the Temple was destroyed, 
that I have entered My house, 
and that I have entered in settlement? 
Not so! 
For I do not enter all the while you are in exile.’²

If so, what is the meaning of *when a nest will happen to be... ?* 
But when the Shekhinah has no ‘place’,

נשמתא דאיהי קבועה בצלותא או באורית' 
איהי אתר קבוע לשריא בה שכינתא. 
אבל נשמתא דלית לה קביעו בצלותא או באוריתא 
אלא אי אזדמנת לה במקרה.

As souls act, so does the Shekhinah abide with them: 
a soul which is habitual in prayer or in Torah, 
is a permanent place for the Shekhinah to abide therein. 
But a soul which is not habitual in prayer or in Torah, 
unless encountered through happenstance, 
so, She also, abides upon it through happenstance.

דבגינהון שריא שכינתא על ישראל. 
או ביצים אלין אינון תינוקות של בית רבן 
דבגינהון שריא שכינתא על ישראל 
ואלין אינון מארי *מקרא. 
ובזמנא דאינון עסקין באורייתא או במצוה 
דאנון קב"ה ושכינתא. 
וגרמי לחברא לון כחדא 
ירתין מתמן נשמתין 
ואתקריאו בנים דקב"ה


*Chicks* – these are the scholars, 
for whose sake the Shekhinah resides upon Israel, 
*or* *eggs* – these are the school children, 
for whose sake the Shekhinah resides upon Israel, 
and these are ‘the Masters of Scripture’. 
And when they are occupied in Torah or in precept¹, 
– which are the blessed Holy One and the Shekhinah – 
and cause Them to join as one, 
they inherit souls from there, 
and they are called ‘children’ of the blessed Holy One.

footnotes:
¹ mitzvah

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/21a:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/21a:18)


בגין דמארי מקרא ומארי משנה 
אינון מגדפין


Because ‘the Masters of Scripture’ and ‘the Masters of *Mishnah*’, 
they are from Her wings

of Her wings, and therefore: 
(Deut. 22:6) *... and the mother is lying upon the chicks, or on the eggs...

וזמנין איהי עלייהו 
וזמנין אסתלקת מנייהו.


The small-faced sucklings [Var. infants], 
each one has four faces,

beloved children, 
over whom Her ‘innards are moved’,

דאיהו יסוד.

[*Remember* and *Observe*] These correspond to: 
the phylacteries¹ of the head – Yod²,

male and female.

And at that time:

*Eggs* are from the aspect of the angels called *ophanim*, 
*chicks* are from the aspect of the ‘youth’ – Metatron, 
*children* are from the aspect of the throne, 
which is the ‘the tabernacle of peace’, 
which is the nest of the Shekhinah, 
for Higher Mother nests in the throne, 
in the three upper *sephirot*.

The Middle Pillar comprises six *sephirot*, 
nesting in Metatron. 
Lower Mother nests in the ‘wheel’¹, 
of which it is stated: (Ez. 1:15) *... and behold one ophan*¹ *on the earth...*

and from *ophan* are ‘animating-souls’¹, 
and they are in the domains of: 
‘Creation’¹, 
‘Formation’¹, 
‘Making’¹.

## Daf 23b

###### Tikkunei Zohar 23b:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:1)


אתחרב בית שני 
וחשך על פני תהום.


The Second Temple was destroyed – 
is alluded to by (Gen. 1:2) *... and darkness upon the face of the deep...’*


###### Tikkunei Zohar 23b:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:2)


ובגין אלין נשמתין 
דאתבריאו קדם דאתברי עלמא 
ולית לון גופין. 
בגין לאתערא רחמי עלייהו 
הוו מקיימי האי פקודא


And for the sake of those souls, 
who were created before the world was created, 
and they have no bodies therefore, 
in order to arouse mercy over them, 
they Israel would fulfil this precept of sending the nest.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 23b:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:3)


א"ל אבא. 
אם כן ת"ח 
דאיהו מסטרא דמחשבה 
דאתמ' ביה ישראל עלה במחשבה ליבראות 
האי אוריתא איהי בן לתלמיד חכם. 
אם כן אתתא דיליה אמאי צריכא יבום. 
דהא לא שוו אפרשותא מארי מתניתין 
לת"ח משאר בני נשא.


He said to him: ‘But Father, 
if so, then in the case of a scholar, 
who is from the aspect of that thought, 
of which it is stated:¹ ‘Israel arose in thought to be created’, 
then the Torah is like a son to the scholar, 
and thus, why would his wife require levirate marriage, 
for the sages of the *Mishnah* made no distinction, 
between a scholar and other men on this matter?’

###### Tikkunei Zohar 23b:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:4)

לאלין נשמתין דאזלין ערטילאין 
משית יומי בראשית.


He said to him: ‘My son, 
[She] definitely requires levirate marriage, 
for the sake of those souls that have been ‘going naked’, 
since the six days of creation.’


###### Tikkunei Zohar 23b:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:5)


א"ל 
והא כת' לא יחליפנו ולא ימיר אותו וגו' 
וכי האי אתתא דאיהי קדש קדשין 
תהא קינא (נ"א תיקא) למאן דלאו איהו ממינה 
דהא כתיב 
תוצא הארץ נפש חיה למינה 
ולית לה הרכבה אלא ממינה.


He said to him: 
‘But it is written: (Lev. 27:10) *... he shall not swap it or exchange it... etc*. 
And so, how can this wife, who is ‘holy of holies’, 
be a nest [Var. perch ] for one who is not of her ‘type’? 
For it is written: 
(Gen. 1:24) *‘Let the earth bring-forth each living soul, of its type...’ 
*And she should only be ‘grafted’ with her ‘type’.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 23b:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:6)


א"ל בני 
גלגולין אינון רזא דהרכבה 
כגון מאן דמרכיב אילנא דלאו איהו מיניה באילנא אחרא. 
כגון מאן דמרכיבין אלנין דא בדא 
אבל עקרא דאם המר ימירנו 
צריך דיהא קדש בקדש


He said to him: ‘My son, 
reincarnations are of the mystery of ‘grafting’. 
Like one who grafts a tree with another tree that is not of its type, 
like those who graft trees one to another. 
But the principle of (Lev. 27:33) *... and if he shall exchange it at all... 
*is that it needs to be ‘holy’ for ‘holy’.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 23b:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:7)

לא ימיר אותו טוב ברע או רע בטוב. 
דהאי איהו רזא 
דצדיק ורע לו 
רשע וטוב לו.


For there is a tree which is from the aspect of impurity, 
which is evil, and because of that it is stated: 
(Lev. 27:10) *He shall not exchange it, good for bad or bad for good... 
*For this is the mystery, 
of:¹ ‘the righteous-one for whom it is evil, 
and the wicked-one for whom it is good.’

והיה הוא ותמורתו יהי' קדש.


But *if he shall surely exchange it,* (Lev. 27:33) *

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/23b:9)

‘the righteous-one for whom it is good.’

And when that soul which is holy,

it is stated of it: (Gen. 8:9) *And the dove did not find a resting place, 
for the sole of her foot...*


###### Tikkunei Zohar 23b:11

והכי רזא דקן צפור

(Job 33:29) *And behold, all of these does EL do,

And, when it finds a place in which to abide, 
it is stated of it: (Gen. 8:12) *And she did not continue to return to him anymore*, 
[what is *anymore*?] – to come yet another time, 
in ‘grafting’ [reincarnation].

**בראשית** 
יר"א שב"ת. 
דאיהי שכינתא. דעלה אתמר 
*מחלליה מות יומת. 
דעאלו אויבים בחלל דילה 
דאיהו קדש קדשים. 
ואתמר בהון את מקדש יי' טמא 
חלל ממלכה ושריה. 
ושפחה עאלת באתר דגבירה. 
דאיהי נדה שפחה גויה זונה. 
וסאיבת אתרהא 
דתמן הוה נייחא דשכינתא. 
וקלא הוה נחית ואמר 
ירא שבת. 
ואיהי לא עבדת כך 
אלא חלל ממלכה ושריה. 
וברחת שכינתא מתמן.


***Be-REiShYT***¹ is composed of the letters 
YeRE¹ ShaBaT¹ 
which is the Shekhinah, about Whom it is stated: 
(Ex. 31:14) *... its desecrators*¹ *shall surely be put to death... 
*For the enemies have entered into Her ‘space’¹, 
which is the Holy of Holies, 
and it is stated of them: (Num. 19:20) *... he has defiled the sanctuary of Y”Y*,*
* (Lam. 2:2) *He has profaned*¹ *the kingdom and its princes*, 
and the maidservant has entered the place of the mistress, 
for she is ‘menstruant, maidservant, heathen, whore’, 
and she has polluted Her place, 
there that was the resting place of the Shekhinah. 
And a voice descended and said: 
‘Fear¹ Sabbath¹!’ 
And she did not do so, 
but *profaned the kingdom and its princes*, 
and the Shekhinah fled from there.

הה"ד ובאבד רשעים רנה:


The blessed Holy One then said: 
‘Daughter of the wicked guilty one! 
And yet even though Sarai expelled her, 
I was merciful upon her and upon her son, 
but you did not do so, 
rather, you caused [Var. bestowed] evil instead of good. 
I promise to remove the wicked kingdom from the world, 
and there shall be no joy before Me, 
until they are vanquished from the world 
– and at that time, there shall there be joy before Me.’ 
Thus it is written: (Prov. 11:10) *And in the perishing of the wicked there is joy*.

אבל כתרין תתאין אינון קליפין לגבי כתרין עלאין 
דמתלבשין בהון עשר אתוון 
(בצלותא) (ס"א בגלותא) 
למהוי כפויין תחותוי כתרין תתאין


For thus there are ten ‘lower crowns’, because 
‘one corresponding to the other did the blessed Holy One create’. 
But the ‘lower crowns’ are husks, in relation to the higher crowns, 
in which the ten letters are enclothed 
[in prayer¹ ] [Var. in exile¹ ], 
in order that ‘the lower crowns’ be subjugated beneath it.

Then, the King enters His chamber, which is ADNY, 
like this: Y-A-Q-D-V-N-Q-Y.

ותלת בתראין חתמין.


In the first three blessings of the ‘standing’ prayer, 
a person should organise his praise, 
like a servant who organises his praise before his Master. 
For these three blessings write all merit, 
and the final three blessings seal them.

## Daf 26b

###### Tikkunei Zohar 26b:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/26b:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/26b:1)


**תּקונא חד סר ליום ז**


**Tiqun Eleven For Day 7**


###### Tikkunei Zohar 26b:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/26b:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/26b:2)


**בראשית** 
בר"א שי"ת. 
ומאי ניהו. 
שית היכלין (לקבל שית יומי בראשית) 
אלקים. אימא עלאה. עלייהו. 
דאיהי היכלא שביעאה.


***Be-REiShYT***¹ can be read as two words: 
BaRA¹ ShYT¹. 
And what are they? 
Six chambers. [corresponding to the six days of creation], 
ELQYM – Higher Mother – is above them, 
for She is the seventh chamber.

¹ In-the-beginning
¹ He-created
¹ six


###### Tikkunei Zohar 26b:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/26b:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/26b:3)


וכמה דאימא עלאה אפיקת שית. 
הכי אימא תתאה אפיקת שית. 
ומאי ניהו 
את השמים ואת הארץ. 
ואינון שית מאנין דאתמר בהון 
כי ששת ימים עשה יי' את השמים ואת הארץ. 
והיכלין תתאין אינון מאנין להיכלין עלאין.


And just as Higher Mother produces six, 
so does Lower Mother produce six. 
And what are they? 
(Gen. 1:1) *... the heavens and the earth*. 
And they are six vessels of which it is stated: 
(Ex. 20:11) *For in six days did Y”Y make the heavens and the earth... 
*And the lower chambers are vessels for the higher chambers.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 26b:4

כל היכלין אלין הוו מתפתחן לגבייהו.


And when Israel would pray, 
all these chambers would open towards them.

ומלאכיא דממנן על צלותין לבר מהיכליהון. 
הה"ד 
הן אראלם צעקו *חוצה. 
ולא אית לון לצלותין אתר לאעלא.


But now, during the exile, it is stated¹ of them, 
that all the gates are closed, 
and the Shekhinah is outside Her chamber, 
and the Blessed Holy One is outside His chamber. 
And the angels appointed over prayer are outside their chambers. 
It is this that is written: 
(Is. 33:7) *Behold their mighty-ones are shouting outside... 
*And there is no place for prayers to enter.

ודא איהו כל השערים ננעלו.

And this is the meaning of ‘all the gates are closed, 
but the gates of tears are not closed.’

והנה נער בכה 
ולית היכלא מתפתחא אלא ביה


And there is none who can open these gates, 
until the ‘Master of Tears’ shall arrive, 
of whom it is stated: (Ex. 2:6) *And she opened, and she saw the boy, 
and behold, it was a crying child... 
*– and no chamber can be opened except by him.

במאי אתפתח ליה 
בדמעה 
הה"ד והנה נער בכה

And this is the meaning of... *and she opened...

a chamber towards him 
[it is this that is written: *ADNY! Open my lips* (Ps. 51:17) ]. 
With what did it open for him? 
With tears. 
It is this that is written*:... and behold, a crying child... 
*And immediately: *she took pity upon him*.

*And this is: (Jer. 31:8) *With crying they shall come... 
*– with the merit of his crying [Var. tears], 
they will be gathered from exile.

And there is a Chamber of Light,

## Daf 27a

###### Tikkunei Zohar 27a:1

**תּקונא תּריסר**


**Tiqun Twelve**

**בראשי״ת 
מאמר** קדמאה דכלא 
כלילא מעשר אמירן. 
ואיהי ל"ב אלקים דעובדא דבראשי' 
(ס"א דברי"ת א"ש) 
ומסטרא דשמאלא אתייהיבת 
דאיהי גבורה אשא סומקא.

***Be-REiShYT***¹ 
– An **Utterance** which is the first of all, 
comprised of all ‘ten sayings’. 
And it is the 32¹ ELQYMs of ‘the act of Be-REiShYT’, 
[Var: of BRYT-EiSh¹ ], 
and from the left side it was given, 
which is Gevurah –the red fire. 
And because of this: (Ex. 3:2) *... in the heart*¹ *of the fire... 
*And Moses was from the side of the Levites, 
from its actual side.

herbs and grasses, who are the sages, 
sprout from there like a garden, 
because She is the Oral Torah.

From ‘the house of Y”Y’. 
It is this that is written: (Joel 4:18) *... and a well-spring shall go forth, 
from the House of Y”Y...*

do not bring it the fruit to the house of Y”Y, 
then milk becomes mixed with meat, 
and it causes the mingling of ox and donkey, 
and this is a ‘forbidden-mixture’¹, 
of a species with one that is not of its own species.’

## Daf 30b

###### Tikkunei Zohar 30b:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/30b:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/30b:1)


ובגין דא 
ראשית בכורי אדמתך 
תביא בית יי' אלקיך 
לא תבשל גדי בחלב אמו. 
דההוא בר איהו ערבוביא 
דנפיק כלאים 
מאתתא דלאו מיניה 
דאיהי כנגדו.


And therefore: 
(Ex. 23:19) *The first of the fruits of your land, 
you shall bring to the house of Y”Y ELoQeYKha... 
*is followed by*... you shall not cook a kid in its mother’s milk*, 
because that resulting child is a mixture, 
which emerges in a state of forbidden-mixing¹ 
– from a woman that is not of his type. 
For she is described as (Gen. 2:18) *against him*¹.

בפקודא בדחילו וברחימו 
עזר לו בעלמא דין ובעלמא דאתי.


And thus, if he merits, she is his *help*¹,² 
his partner, she who is his help in Torah, 
in precept, in fear, and in love, 
a ‘help’ for him in this world, and in the world to come.

דאיבא דיליה סם חיים 
בת זוגיה 
נטירא ליה בעלמא דין ובעלמא דאתי.

For this is the Tree of Life, 
Whose fruit is the ‘elixir of life’, 
his coupling partner, 
preserved for him in this world, and in the world to come. 
About her it is stated: (Gen. 3:22) *... and he shall also take from the tree of life, 
and shall eat and live forever*. 
The word “also” comes to include his coupling partner, 
his elixir of life 
– which is preserved for him in this world, 
and in the world to come. 
And any other one who wishes to take his partner, 
Like Uriah who preceded David, 
it is stated of him: (Jer. 2:3) *... all who eat of it will be rendered guilty, 
evil shall come upon them, says Y”Y*.

anyone who belittles ‘the bread’,

## Daf 32a

###### Tikkunei Zohar 32a:1

י' חכמה אבא.

ואנת הוית בדיוקניה


Higher Mother¹, 
Yod² – Ḥokhmah – Father, 
Tav² – Tipheret, a ‘son of the house’ above 
– and you were in its image.

² י
² ת


###### Tikkunei Zohar 32a:2

אלא ברשו


For in that [Var. for to this] house, 
no prophet or seer has authority to enter there, 
except by permission.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 32a:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/32a:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/32a:3)

And yet you would enter without permission, 
like the son of the king, 
for whom no gate there is closed.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 32a:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/32a:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/32a:4)


ולא עוד 
אלא דנביאיא אחרנין לא הוו עאלין למחמי למלכא 
אלא בשעתין ידיעאן וביומין ידיעאן 
כגוונא דאשכחנא באהרן דהוה עלאה מכלהו 
דאתמר ביה 
ואל יבא בכל עת אל הקדש 
אלא בזאת יבא אהרן אל הקדש. 
כ"ש אחרנין. 
ואנת בכל שעתא ושעתא ובכל יומא דאנת בעי 
הוית עייל למחזי למלכא.


And not only that, 
but other prophets would not enter to see the King, 
except at specified hours and certain days, 
as we find with Aaron, who was higher than all the others, 
that it is stated of him: 
(Lev. 16:2) *... and he shall not come at*just *any time to the sacred... 
*but rather: (Lev. 16:3) *In ‘this’*¹² *shall Aaron come to the sacred... 
*How much more so, others! 
And yet you, at any hour and on any day that you wished, 
would enter to see the King.

¹ zot
² Malkhut


###### Tikkunei Zohar 32a:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/32a:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/32a:5)


ולא עוד 
אלא כל נביאיא 
הוו חזיין (נ"א משיגין) נבואה דלהון 
באברין דמלכא. 
כל חד וחד באבר ידיעא ולא יתיר. 
מנהון ברישא דמלכא. 
מנהון בנימין דרישא 
דאנון ככביא ומזלי דלית לון חושבנא. 
מנהון בעיינין 
מנהון באודנין. 
מנהון באנפין. 
מנהון בחוטמא. 
מנהון בפימא. 
מנהון בצואר. 
מנהון בידים. 
מנהון בקומה דאיהו גופא. 
מנהון בשוקין. 
מנהון באות ברית. 
מנהון בלבושין דמלכא 
דלא הוה לון רשו לאסתכלא יתיר.


And not only that, 
but all other prophets, 
would see [Var. comprehend] their prophecy 
through the limbs of the King, 
each one through a specific limb and not more – 
some of them through the head of the King, 
some through the hairs of the head, 
which are numberless stars and constellations, 
some of them through the eyes, 
some of them through the ears, 
some of them through the face, 
some of them through the nose, 
some of them through the mouth, 
some of them through the neck, 
some of them through the hands, 
some of them through ‘the stature’ – which is the body, 
some of them through the thighs, 
some of them through ‘the sign of the covenant’, 
some of them through the garments of the King, 
– for they have no permission to look further.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 32a:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/32a:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/32a:6)

מה דלא הוה הכי לשאר כל נביאיא.


But Moses, 
through every limb and through every place, 
would comprehend his prophecy. 
And through every limb would She¹ descend towards him, 
which was not the case with any of the other prophets.

דהוו צריכין ליה עבדוי ואפרכסוי 
וממנן ושלטני ארעא למחזי עמיה. 
כל חד כפום צרכוי. 
וכל חד כפום שלטנותיה. 
וכל חד כפום עסקוי. 
מה עבד מלכא. 
שוי כלא בידא דמטרוניתא ואמר 
כל מאן דבעי למשאל שאלתוי ייתי למטרוניתא 
דאיהי בית דילי. בית י'

והאי איהו אל יתהלל המתהלל

It is likened to a King, 
whose servants and ministers required him, 
and appointees and rulers of the land sought to appear with him,

and each one according to his specific rule,

‘Anyone who wants to ask a request, shall come to the Queen, 
Who is My ‘house’, the house of Yod¹ 
[Var. BaYiT² is BaT² and Yod¹ ], 
– My chamber.’

... *of understanding, knowing me... 
except through ‘this’*² *...*

At that time, they all knock upon the opening [Var. at the gate],

and over there is Patḥon who opens. 
Immediately, the Faithful Shepherd arrives, 
and he says: *ADNY! Open my lips...*

ופסקין לה על שיחה בטלה


And these are the wicked, 
who disrespect the King with their prayers, 
for they ignore hearing the prayer, 
and they interrupt prayer with mundane conversation.

ע"י שליחא או ממנא.


And he is not worthy of entering the chamber of the King, 
and about him it is stated: (Deut. 24:11) *Outside shall you stand... 
*And from outside, they grant him his request, 
by means of an emissary or appointee.

אז יקראנני ולא אענה

they expel him to the outside, and they shut the door in his face. 
And about that is stated: 
(Prov. 1:28) *Then shall they call me,* *but I shall not answer, 
they will seek me out early, but they will not find me*.

then He does not descend there.

When They these Holy Names are in Father and in Mother,

like this: Y-A-Q-Q-V-Y-Q-Q.

branches separating to right and to left.

they are, both-of-them, in complete unity. 
And likewise, there are branches separating in Netzaḥ and Hod: 
YQV”Q to the right, EQY”Q to the left.

###### Tikkunei Zohar 35a:6

Worthy are Israel, 
for they are the feet of the Shekhinah,

## Daf 35b

###### Tikkunei Zohar 35b:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/35b:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/35b:1)


ביומא דדינא 
דאיהי ר"ה 
איהי קמת עמהון לדינא 
דקיימין לה בצלותהון. 
דעלייהו אתמר בהתהלכך תנחה אותך 
בשכבך תשמור עליך 
והקיצות היא תשיחך.


on ‘the Day of Judgement’, 
which is New Year¹, 
She stands with them for judgement, 
for they stand Her up with their prayers, 
for upon them it is written: (Prov. 6:22) *In your walking it will guide you, 
in your lying-down it will watch over you, 
and in your waking-up it is your conversation...*

###### Tikkunei Zohar 35b:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/35b:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/35b:2)


דבכל אתר דקיימין ישראל 
בכל פקודא ופקודא 
לשכינתא. 
איהי קיימת בגינייהו בכל דוחקא וצערא 
בין בארחא 
בין בישובא 
בין בימא. 
ודא איהו בהתהלכך במדברא תנחה אותך. 
הה"ד צדק לפניו יהלך 
וישם לדרך פעמיו. 
בשכבך בישובא תשמור עליך. 
והקיצות למחת (ס"א למיזל) בימא 
היא תשיחך.


For in every place that Israel causes to stand 
– in each-and-every precept – 
the Shekhinah, 
She stands for their sake in every oppression and trouble: 
whether on the way, 
whether in settlement, 
whether on the sea. 
And this is: *in your walking* – in the desert – *it will guide you*. 
It is this that is written: (Ps. 85:14) *Righteousness shall go before him 
and shall place his steps along the way*. 
*... in your lying-down...*– in settlement – *it will watch over you...* (Prov. 6:22) *
... and in your waking-up* – to sail [Var. to go] on the sea 
– *it is your conversation*.

בשכבך בקבר תשמור עליך 
והקיצות בת"ה 
היא תשיחך


And furthermore: 
... *in your walking...*– in this world¹ –... *it will guide you*. 
... *in your lying-down...*– in the grave –... *it will watch over you... 
... and in your waking-up...*– at the resurrection of the dead – 
*it is your conversation*.

דאתמר ביה וגוייתו כתרשיש.

דביה אתפתחון חמש נהורין 
הה"ד 
נפתחו השמים ואראה מראות אלקים.


These then exit, 
behold, ‘the masters of stature’ are knocking at the entrance 
– which is the stature of the body of the King, 
of which it is stated: (Dan. 10:6) *And its body as ‘tarshish’*. 
And it is this which is called ‘heavens’, 
through which are opened five lights. 
It is this that is written: 
(Ez. 1:1) *... the heavens opened and I saw visions of ELQYM*.

*She is most certainly ‘hidden in the light’¹, 
and through Her is made AVYR¹.

דחמש חמש לכל סטרא.


And the mystery of the matter: 
‘The Tree of Life was five hundred years long,’¹ 
– and between each one is five hundred years, 
and the thickness of each one is five hundred years,² 
for all of them add up on ‘the scale’, 
of five, five to every side.

And the mystery of the matter: 
(Ex. 26: 26–27) *And you shall make poles of acacia wood, 
five for the planks of one side of the Tabernacle... 
... and five poles for the planks of the other side of the Tabernacle... 
... and five poles for the planks of the side of the Tabernacle 
for the ‘rear-parts’ to the west. 
... for the rear-parts* – these are ‘the thighs of truth’¹, 
... *to the west*² – what is ‘to the west?’ – 
this is the Higher Shekhinah, 
 that of which is stated:

אין מלכות נוגעת בחברתה אפילו כמלא נימא.

And this is what they the sages established:¹ 
‘There is nothing between the higher waters and the lower waters, 
but a hair's breadth.’ 
And of this hair it is stated:² 
‘No kingdom touches upon its fellow, even by a hair’s breadth’. 
And with it: ‘the blessed Holy One is exact with the righteous, 
even as a thread of hair’.³ 
And this thread is the thread 
that encompasses the sign of the covenant of circumcision. 
And the covenant is a ‘hair-strand’.

And on the Sabbath,

and do not add to Sabbath and festivals, 
it is closed for them. 
And thus: ‘all who add, they add to him’,² 
and this is the addition of ‘the extra soul’, 
and it is the addition of ‘a spirit of holiness’. 
And all who detract from the Sabbath – 
they deprive him of that extra soul, 
and he remains poor. 
And if he is wise, his wisdom is removed from him, 
and if he is wealthy in money, it his wealth is removed from him, 
and he is left as a dry, poor man.

## Daf 43b

###### Tikkunei Zohar 43b:1

small,

###### Tikkunei Zohar 43b:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/43b:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/43b:2)


נחש בריח 
דא ההוא דאתמר ביה 
הבריח התיכון בתוך הקרשים. 
ודא עמודא דאמצעיתא דאתקרי תיכון 
בגין דאיהו עמודא דאמצעיתא. 
תרין גדפוי ימינא ושמאלא 
דמתמן אוריתא אתיהיבת. 
תרין קשקשוי תרין סמכי קשוט.


The ‘*bariaḥ*¹ **snake’: 
this is the one of whom it is stated: 
(Ex. 26:28) *... the middle pole*¹ *within the planks... 
*– and this is the Middle Pillar which is called ‘middle’¹, 
because it is the Middle Pillar. 
Its two ‘fins’, right and left, 
are from where the Torah is given, 
its two ‘scales’ – the two pillars of truth².

Higher Shekhinah is the sea.

**Opened** Rabbi El’azar and said: ‘Father! 
But there are seven seas,¹

and it is stated about it:

א״ל ברי 
שבעה בשבעה אינון מוצקות. 
והכי אינון רקיעים שבעה בשבעה. 
והכי אינון טורין שבעה בשבעה. 
והכי אינון ארעין שבעה בשבעה. 
ישובין שבעה בשבעה. 
וראשין דלהון תרין. 
ורזא דמלה 
שנים שנים 
שבעה שבעה. 
וכלהו זכר ונקבה. 
ולעילא חד גניז וטמיר. 
והכי אינון שבע כרסיין שבעה בשבעה. 
שבע היכלין שבעה בשבעה. 
והכי ממנן אינון שבעה ושבעה.


He said to him: ‘My son, 
(Zech. 4:2) *... seven into* *seven...*are*... tubes*. 
And thus are the firmaments – seven into seven, 
and thus are the mountains – seven into seven, 
and so are the lands – seven into seven, 
the settlements – seven into seven, 
and their heads are two, 
and the mystery of the matter: 
(Gen. 7:9) *Two by two... 
* (Gen. 7:2) *... seven by seven... 
*and all are male and female, 
and above, is one that is concealed and hidden, 
and so are the seven thrones – seven into seven, 
seven chambers – seven into seven, 
and so are ‘the appointed’ angels – seven and seven.¹

כליל שית סדרין.

דא שכינתא

*– these are the Patriarchs, 
*the argument of Y”Y 
*– this is the Shekhinah,

מי זאת עולה. 
עולה ודאי. 
מן המדבר מן המדבר ודאי. 
דפימוי 
חשיב קב״ה כטורא דסיני. 
ובג״ד מי זאת עולה מן המדבר וגו׳ 
מקטרת מר דא צלותא דשחרית 
דתקון אברהם 
דהוא מר.


Worthy is he who elevates Her towards Him appropriately, 
for He enquires of Her: 
(Song, 3:6) *Who is ‘this’*¹ *rising*¹ *...* 
– rising, certainly! 
...*from the desert?...*– from the desert certainly! 
For his mouth which utters prayer, 
the blessed Holy One considers as Mount Sinai, 
and because of this: *Who is this that is rising from the desert? etc*. 
...*perfumed with myrrh...*– this is the prayer of the morning service, 
established by Abraham, 
who is myrrh.²

¹ ’olah
² Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:8


###### Tikkunei Zohar 45a:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/45a:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/45a:23)


ועוד 
מקוטרת מר.

דסליק לה בימינא.

נעימות בימינך נצח 
ולבונה דא הוד 
דסליק לה בגבורה. 
מכל אבקת רוכל. דא צדיק 
דסליק לה בעמודא דאמצעיתא.


And furthermore: 
...*perfumed with myrrh... 
* (Song. 1:13) *A bundle of myrrh is my beloved to me... 
*– and this is Netzaḥ, 
which he elevates for Her on the right-hand side, 
it is this that is written: 
(Ps. 16:11) *... pleasantness in your right hand forever*¹. 
(Song. 3:6) *... and frankincense...*– this is Hod, 
which he elevates for Her in Gevurah. 
*... over all the powder of the perfumer*– this is the Righteous-One, 
which he elevates for Her in the Middle Pillar.

And if he does not elevate the Shekhinah with his prayer,

then a dog descends to eat his offering. 
Woe to him! It were better had he not been created in the world, 
and about him it is stated: 
(Prov. 19:2) *Also without knowledge, a soul is not good...*

## Daf 45b

###### Tikkunei Zohar 45b:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/45b:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/45b:1)


מאן גוזליו 
אלין אינון ישראל 
דאינון כגוזלייא מצפצפין לה 
בכמה צפצופין דצלותא 
ונחתת לגבייהו. 
לכל חד נחתא ליה מזונא כדקא יאות ליה. 
למאן נחתא מזונא דאוריתא 
דאיהו מזונא דנשמתא. 
למאן נחתא מזונא דגופא. 
לכל חד כפום רעותי׳


Who are... *its chicks... ?* 
These are Israel, 
who are like chicks, chirping to Her, 
with the many chirpings of prayer, 
and She descends towards them. 
To each one She brings down the sustenance appropriate to him: 
to one She brings down the sustenance of Torah, 
which is sustenance of the soul, 
to another She brings down sustenance of the body 
– to each according to his desire.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 45b:2

**אֵם**תשכבון

דאיהי נשמת כל חי 
איהי נחתא על ראש צדיק 
דאיהו יום השביעי:


Another word on the verse: 
***Eim (Ps. 68:14)***¹ *if* *you will lie down*... 
– this is Higher ‘Mother’¹, which is the Sabbath prayer 
– whom the ‘lips’ are required to receive on the eve of Sabbath, 
for She is ‘the soul of all life’¹, 
She descends upon ‘the head of the righteous’, 
– which is the seventh day.

(Is. 50:4) *... a tongue of studies* they call it, 
and She resides upon it ‘between the two lips’, 
which are Netzaḥ and Hod.

The prayer of the six weekdays,

the totality of the eighteen prayers,

though it be bitter like an olive, 
and let it not be delivered by a messenger though it be sweet’, 
and ‘the messenger’ in this instance is Metatron.

Another word: 
(Mic. 6:2) ***Hear,** O mountains, the argument of Y”Y... 
*What is ‘*the argument*¹ *of Y”Y*’? And who are *the mountains*? 
The ‘argument of Ha*-Shem*’ is the Shekhinah, 
*the mountains* are the Patriarchs, 
*the argument*–**She is controversy and debate 
for the blessed Holy One, 
over Her children who are in exile.

## Daf 46a

###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:1)


דשבת 
דאתוסף לעני דאיהו צדיק 
יום השבת ודאי. 
דלית ליה מדיליה אלא נשמת׳ יתירה 
*דאתוסף לגביה בגין שכינתא 
אתקרי איהו מוסף שבת.


of the Sabbath, 
which is ‘added’ to the poor-one, who is the Righteous-One, 
– the day of Sabbath, surely. 
For he has nothing of his own except an ‘extra soul’, 
which is added to him because of the Shekhinah, 
– it is called ‘additional’¹ of the Sabbath.

footnotes:
¹ musaph


###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:2)


**ובההוא** זמנא 
אתקריאת איהי תוספתא 
מסטרא דיום שבת 
כמה תוספות נחתין עמה לתלמידי חכמי׳ 
דאתקריאו נשמות יתירות 
הה״ד נשמת כל חי 
תברך את שמך יי׳ אלקינו כו׳


**And at that** time, 
She is called ‘addition’¹. 
From the aspect of the Sabbath Day, 
many additions descend with Her to the scholars, 
which are these additions called ‘extra souls’. 
It is this that is written:² ‘the soul of all life’ – 
shall bless Your Name, Y”Y ELoQeYNU etc.’

footnotes:
¹ tosephta
² Liturgical: Sabbath Morning Service, Nishmat prayer


###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:3)


ואלין (אינון) דמתוספאן לעמא קדישא 
בערב שבת 
ירתין לון ת״ח ביומין דחול. 
ובהון אתעביד חול קדש. 
ואלין אינון תוספות 
דקא נחתין מתוספת׳ 
דודאי שכינתא איהי תקונא 
דגופא דקב״ה.


And these [are they] that are added to the holy people 
on the Sabbath eve, 
are inherited by scholars on weekdays, 
and with them is the mundane made holy, 
and these are the ‘additions’¹, 
which descend from the ‘Additional’¹, 
for surely the Shekhinah is a construct, 
of the body of the blessed Holy One.

¹ tosaphot
¹ tosephta


###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:4)


איהי בריתא 
כד אתמ׳ בה ותגל מרגלותיו


She is *braiyta*, 
when it is stated of Her: (Ruth 3:7) *and she uncovered his feet.*


###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:5)


ואיהי תוספתא 
מסטרא דח״י עלמין 
דאיהו מוסף שבת.


And She is *tosephta*, 
from the aspect of ‘the life-force of the worlds’, 
which is the additional¹ of the Sabbath.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:6)


ואיהי משנה 
מסטר׳ דגופא 
משנה תורה ודאי.


And She is *Mishnah*, 
from the aspect of the body, 
the ‘second’¹ of the Torah, certainly.

¹ mishneh


###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:7)


ואיהי התקפא 
מסטרא דדרועא ימינא דמלכא 
הה״ד ימינך יי׳ נאדרי בכח. 
בכח תרגום בתוקפא.


And She is ‘a challenge’¹, 
from the aspect of the right arm of the King. 
It is this that is written: (Ex. 15:6) *Your right-arm Y”Y is adorned with power 
*– *with power*¹ in Aramaic translation is ‘with might’¹.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:8)


הצרכה איהי מסטרא דשמאלא. 
ובדרועא שמאלא אחיד בה 
ובדרועא ימינא אתקן בה 
ויימא קומי שבי ירושלם.


As ‘a necessity’¹ – She is from the left side, 
and with the left arm He takes hold of Her, 
and with the right arm he affixes Her, 
and says: (Is. 52:2) *Rise! Sit O Jerusalem...*

###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:9)


ועוד 
מסטר׳ דימינא איהי תוקפא לבר נש 
ומסטרא דשמאלא יהיב לון צרכיהון 
בארע מדברא.


And furthermore, 
from the right side She is the might of a person, 
and from the left side it gives to them their needs, 
in a desert land.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:10)


שאלה איהי בפימא דמלכא 
הה״ד שאל אביך. 
ותיובתא לגביה 
הה״ד ויגדך.


As ‘a question’¹ – She is in the mouth of the King, 
it is this that is written: (Deut. 32:7) *... ask your father*, 
and the ‘answer’¹ to him, 
it is this that is written:... *and he shall tell you...*

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:11)


ובה בר נש שואל כענין 
ומשיב כהלכה.


And through it does a person ‘ask according to the subject, 
and respond in accordance with the law’.¹

¹ Mishnah Avot 5:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:12)


שמעתתא 
איהי בלבא דתמן מחשבה.


‘That which is heard’¹ of tradition 
– it is in the heart, for thought is there.

footnotes:
¹ shama’atta


###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:13)


תיקו 
איהי כד אסתלק מלכא מינה 
הה״ד נאלמתי דומיה 
החשתי מטוב. ובה צלותא בחשאי. 
וכד איהי תיקו אתמר בה 
אז יקראונני ולא אענה.


‘Inconclusive’¹ 
– is when the King withdraws from Her. 
It is this that is written: (Ps. 39:3) *I was struck dumb, 
I was silent from the good* – and in it is silent prayer. 
And when She is *teyqu*¹, it is stated of Her: 
(Prov. 1:28) *Then shall they call me, and I will not answer*.

###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:14)


כד שריא בה יקו״ק 
אתקריאת הגדה. 
בההוא זמנא אז תקרא ויי׳ יענה.


When YQV”Q resides in Her discussion, 
She is called ‘narrative’¹. 
At that time: (Is. 58:9) *Then shall you call, and Y”Y will answer*.

¹ hagadah


###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:15)


שטה אתקריאת

הה״ד כל גיא ינשא 
וכל הר וגבעה ישפלו 
והיה העקב למישור.


She is called ‘perspective’¹, 
when there is no difficult question or dispute, 
it is this that is written: (Is. 40:4) *Every valley shall be raised, 
and every mountain and hill shall be brought low, 
and the crooked way shall be a straight plane*.

###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:16)


פסק אתקריאת מכמה גוונין. 
אית בני נשא דמשתדלין באוריתא דבע״פ לשמה 
ואינון בעלי אומנות לגבה. 
אית דפסקין בה אבנין 
כטורין וסלעין תקיפין 
ולבתר דפסקין לון 
מתקנין לון בכמה פרוקין. 
ועלייהו אתמר אבנים שלמות תבנה. 
ועבדין בהון כמה בנינין 
למלכא ולמטרוניתא 
לדיירא בינייהו.


She is called ‘final decision’¹ in several ways. 
There are people who strive in the Oral Torah for its own sake, 
and they are ‘craftsmen’ in relation to Her. 
There are those who hew¹ stones in Her, 
like mountains and mighty rocks, 
and after they hew them, 
they ‘fix’ them up, with many*pheruqinn*¹¹, 
and upon them is stated: (Deut. 27:6) *with* *complete stones you shall build it*, 
and they make many buildings with them, 
for the King and the Queen, 
that They may dwell among them.

¹ pasqinn
¹ breaks
¹ answers


###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:17)


ואית פסקות 
דאינון לבושין דמטרוניתא 
וחתכין לון לכמה סטרין 
ולבתר מתקנין לון בכמה פרוקין 
לאתחזאה בהון מטרוניתא קדם מלכא. 
בההוא זמנא 
וראיתיה לזכור ברית עולם. 
ואלין אינון לבושין דכהנא 
דאינון ארבע בגדי לבן וארבע בגדי זהב


And there are ‘rendered decisions’¹, 
which are garments for the Queen, 
and they ‘cut’ them to many sides, 
after which they fix them up with many ‘sectional answers’¹, 
so that the Queen shall appear adorned with them before the King. 
At that time: 
(Gen. 9:16) *... and I shall see it to remember the eternal covenant... 
*And these are the priestly garments, 
which are four garments of white, and four garments of gold.

###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:18)


ואית פסקות מאלין מארי תריסין 
דקא אתיין לבי מדרשא 
דפסקין וחתכין בהון בלישנהון 
דאינון כרומחין וסייפין. 
ואלין אינון פרשיין ותקיפין 
כמגיחין קרבא בימא וביבשתא 
דאינון אורייתא דבכתב ואוריתא דבע״פ


And there are ‘rendered decisions’ from those masters of shields, 
who come to the house of study, 
who hew and cut them with their tongues, 
which are like spears and swords. 
And they are mounted riders, and fierce, 
like warriors of war on the sea and on dry-land, 
which are the Written Torah and the Oral Torah.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:19)


זכאין אינון אם מלכא בינייהו 
דאיהו עמודא דאמצעית׳ כליל תרין תורות 
דאנון תורה שבכתב ותורה שבע״פ 
דאתייהיבו מימינא ומשמאלא 
דביה נצחין קרבא.


Worthy they are, if the King is among them! 
For He is the Middle Pillar – comprising two Torahs, 
which are the Written Torah and the Oral Torah, 
which were given from the right and from the left, 
with which they are victorious in war.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 46a:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:20)


ווי לון לאלין דיעלון לאגחא קרבא 
בתרין תורות בלא מלכא 
דעלייהו אתמר אין אמר ואין דברים 
בלי נשמע קולם.


Woe to those who enter to wage battle, 
armed with two Torahs but without ‘the King’, 
for upon them it is stated: (Ps. 19:4) *None say and there are no words, 
their voice is not heard*.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:21)


כל בעלי אומניות משתכחין בתורה שבע״פ 
ואיהי מלגאו הה״ד 
כל כבודה בת מלך פנימה.


All the craftsmen are found occupied in the Oral Torah 
– and She is inside. It is this that is written: 
(Ps. 45:14) *All the glory of the king’s daughter is within*.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/46a:22)


איהי הלכה *דמלכא 
כד איהי אזלת גביה בתרין שוקין 
דאינון תרי סמכי קשוט. 
וכד סליקת בגופא 
בתרין דרועוי דמלכא 
אתקריאת קבלה.


She is the ‘going’¹ of the King, 
when She goes towards Him with two thighs, 
which are ‘the two pillars of truth’, 
and when She ascends in the body, 
in the two arms of the King, 
She is called ‘acceptance’¹.

וכד נשיקת ליה בפימיה 
אתקריאת אוריתא דבע״פ

מיד יתקיים ברעיא מהימנא 
פה אל פה אדבר בו.

She is called the Oral Torah. 
At that time, when She ascends to the mouth of the King, 
then it is fulfilled of the Faithful Shepherd Moses: 
(Num. 12:8) *Mouth to mouth I will speak with him...*

כד קמת על רגלהא בגלותא בתראה
 אתקריאת הלכה למשה מסיני

When She stands upon Her feet in the final exile, 
She is called ‘the law to Moses from Sinai’.¹ 
And when She resides in the arms

of the King,

###### Tikkunei Zohar 46b:9

דא חיר״ק. 
ריב יי׳ לעילא חול״ם. 
ריב יי׳ לתתא חיר״ק. 
תרי ריבות אינון על שור״ק 
דאיהו (חד) צדיק 
קשורא דתרוייהו.


What is: *the argument of Y”Y*? 
This is ḥireq¹. 
*argument of Y”Y* above is ḥolem¹,

ולא עוד 
אלא דאיהי אתקריאת שבת 
דאיהי אסור במלאכה 
בגין דאתקריאת חרות.


And moreover: 
but She is called ‘Sabbath’, 
for She is forbidden in work, 
because She is called ‘freedom’¹.

footnotes:
¹ ḥerut


###### Tikkunei Zohar 48a:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48a:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48a:22)


ושלמה בגינה אמר 
אמרתי אחכמה 
והיא רחוקה ממני. 
בגין פרה אדומה 
דאיהי מטהרת את הטמא 
ומטמאה את הטהור דאתעסק בה.


And because of Her, Solomon said: 
(Ecc. 7:23) *... I said I shall become wise, 
and it or She is far from me* 
– because of the red cow, 
‘who purifies the defiled, 
and defiles the pure who is occupied with it.’


###### Tikkunei Zohar 48a:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48a:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48a:23)


ורזא דמלה 
מי יתן טהור מטמא לא אחד. 
מטהרת את הטמא מסטר׳ דימינא. 
דכהנא מסטרא דימינא אתקרי איש טהור. 
בגין דלסטרא (נ״א דסטרא) 
דימינא איהי מיא דאורייתא. 
אע״ג דיהא טמא אתדכי בה. 
ומטמאת את הטהור דא גבורה 
דלסטרא סמא״ל דנפל מקדושתיה 
ומה דהוה טהור סאיב ליה 
בגין דשליט


And the mystery of the matter: 
(Job 14:4) *Who can make pure from defilement? Not one!* 
– it purifies the defiled from the right-side, 
for the priest, of the right-side, is called ‘a pure man’, 
for to the side [Var. for the side] 
of the right is the water of the Torah 
– even though he is impure he is purified in it. 
‘And it defiles the pure’ – this is Gevurah, 
on whose side Samael fell from his holiness, 
and that which was pure became defiled, 
because he rules



## Daf 48b

###### Tikkunei Zohar 48b:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:1)


על חיילין דמסאבו.


over the forces of defilement.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 48b:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:2)


וכהנא דאיהו טהור 
כד הוה משתדל לקרבא ליה לעזאזל 
הוה מטהר לישראל מכל חובין דלהון 
כד״א כי ביום הזה יכפר עליכם 
לטהר אתכם כו׳.


And a priest who is pure, 
when he would strive to offer to’Azazel, 
would purify Israel from all its sins, 
as it says: (Lev. 16:30) *For upon this day it will atone for you, 
to purify you etc*.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 48b:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:3)


ואיהו דהוה טהור 
הוה מתטמא בההוא עזאזל.


And he that was pure, 
would become impure through that’Azazel.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 48b:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:4)


והכי למי נדה. 
הוה כהנא מטהר לה 
ואיהו הוה מסתאב עד עדן רמשא 
דהוה מתדכי.


And thus also, regarding the ‘waters of *nidah*’: 
the priest would purify her, 
and would be himself impure until evening time, 
and then would become purified.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 48b:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:5)


ועוד 
מטהר׳ את הטמ׳ 
כד נולד משה 
אתמר ביה לגבי בת פרעה 
ותרא אותו כי טוב הוא 
דחמאת עמיה שכינתא. 
ומיד דנגעה איהי ביה 
אתדכיאת ואתסיאת מצרעתא דילה. 
ומשה אתדבקת ביה צרעת 
כד״א והנה ידו מצורעת כשלג.


And furthermore: 
on the idea of ‘it purifies the impure’. 
When Moses was born, 
it is stated of him in relation to the daughter of Pharaoh: 
(Ex. 2:2) *... and she saw him that he was good... 
*– for she saw the Shekhinah with him, 
and as soon as she touched him, 
she became purified and healed¹ from her leprosy, 
and the leprosy then adhered to Moses, 
as it says: (Ex. 4:6) *... and behold his hand was leprous like snow*.

###### Tikkunei Zohar 48b:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:6)


דבההיא זמנא 
דנגעה ביה בת פרעה 
פרחת שכינתא מניה 
ובג״ד 
כד בעא לאתקרבא לגבה בסנה 
אמר׳ ליה 
אל תקרב הלום של נעליך מעל רגליך 
עד דיתפשט מההוא גופא 
דנגעת ביה בת פרעה.


For at that time, 
when the daughter of Pharaoh touched him, 
the Shekhinah flew away from him, 
and because of this, 
when he wanted to approach Her at the bush, 
She said to him: 
(Ex. 3:5) *... ‘Do not approach here, remove your shoes from your feet’ 
*– until he shall divest himself of that body, 
which the daughter of Pharaoh had touched.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 48b:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:7)

that the body of a person in this world is leprous, 
from the skin of the snake.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 48b:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:8)


לבתר דאתפשט מניה

אתלבש *בגופ׳ קדיש׳ דיליה 
ודא איהו והנה שבה כבשרו.


After he a person becomes divested of it, 
and returns to the Garden of Eden, 
he becomes clothed in his holy body, 
and this is: (Ex. 4:7) *... and behold it returned as his flesh...*


###### Tikkunei Zohar 48b:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:9)

עצם מעצמי ובשר מבשרי.


And thus was Moses enclothed in it. 
And this is... *and behold it returned as his flesh 
*– like it was ‘at first’ with Adam, of whom it is stated: 
... (Gen. 2:23) *bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh*.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 48b:10

ההוא דנגעה ביה בת פרעה 
ואתלבש באחרא. 
ובההוא זמנא 
אהדרת עליה שכינתא.


And because of this, He said to him: 
...*remove your shoes from your feet* (Ex. 3:5) *
*– this is the body, which was as a ‘shoe’ for him, 
that which the daughter of Pharaoh had touched,

Here He alluded to: (Mic. 7:5) *... from the one lying in your breast, 
guard the openings of your mouth*. 
(Ex. 4:6) *And behold*his hand was*leprous like snow*.

###### Tikkunei Zohar 48b:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Tikkunei%20Zohar/r/48b:13)


ועוד 
שכינתא תתאה איהי עגלה ערופה.

ודא איהו ופני שור מהשמאל. 
ומסטרא דעגלה 
*עגל בן בקר לחטאת. 
ופרה ודאי אתקריאת שכינתא עלאה 
כד נטלת מן גבורה. 
ושכינת׳ תתאה עגלה 
כד נטיל׳ מניה


And furthermore: 
the Lower Shekhinah is ‘the calf whose neck is broken’, 
and from the aspect of the cow – it is ‘ox’. 
And this is: (Ez. 1:10) *... and the face of an ox from the left... 
*And from the aspect of the calf: 
(Lev. 9:2) *... a calf of the cattle for a sin offering*. 
And a ‘cow’¹ specifically is called the Higher Shekhinah, 
when it takes from Gevurah, 
and the Lower Shekhinah is called ‘calf’¹, 
when it takes from it.

the cantillation-note *qarnei parah*¹ **is Netzaḥ and Hod,

with which He makes war with’Amaleq, 
and will vanquish him and his seed from the world.

קרני פרה 
אלין תלמידי חכמים 
דמתווכחין דא עם דא באוריתא 
ומתנגחין כשוורים דא עם דא 
בגין דאורייתא דע״פ איהי מסטרא דגבורה 
דאתקרי אלקים. וביה פתחת אוריתא 
בראשית ברא אלקים.


And furthermore: 
the cantillation-note *qarnei parah*¹² 
– these are the scholars, 
who argue with one another in the Torah, 
and gore each other like oxen, 
because the Oral Torah is from the side of Gevurah, 
which is called ELQYM, and with it the Torah opens: 
(Gen. 1:1) *In the beginning, ELQYM created...*

מסטרא דגבורה. 
יריע בתרועה 
יצריח בשברים

it gives the left-overs to her husband.

– until a loaf of bread*,

## Daf 49b

###### Tikkunei Zohar 49b:1

בגין דאיהו שאול תחתית 
דאתמר ביה צדיק ממנו בולע 
אבל צדיק גמור אינו בולע.

is: (Ecc. 7:6) *... the laughter of the fool...*¹ *
*and upon it is stated:² 
‘If you see a wicked person for whom the hour is smiling, 
do not provoke him’, 
because he is destined for the depth of hell, 
of which it is stated: (Ḥab. 1:13) *... the one more righteous than he,*it swallows, 
but the ‘completely righteous-person’ it does not swallow. 
‘The liver gets angry’³ and kills.

לב מבין 
לב יודע 
לב רואה.

דלא נטלא אלא דמא צח 
דאיהי קרבנא דצלותא 
נקיה בלא חובין ובלא פסולת

The heart understands, 
the heart knows, 
the heart sees. 
The heart is the Shekhinah, 
which takes only the pure blood, 
which is the offering of prayer, 
clean, without sin and without refuse, 
and She offers to Her husband the best of everything.


###### Tikkunei Zohar 49b:3

לא יהיבת לבעלה 
אלא שיורין ופסולת. 
ומאי ניהו דעלה. 
(טחול) (ס״א כבד) 
אל אחר. 
ומאלין שיורין דנטיל מנה 
אתעביד דם טחול חשוך ואוכמא 
הוא נחש רמאי 
דפתי לחוה דאיהי לבא 
וגרם לה מותא.


But the extra lobe of the liver, 
does not give to her husband anything, 
except ‘left-overs’ and refuse. 
And what is it that is ‘upon her?’ or: is ‘her husband?’ 
[spleen] [Var. liver] 
– symbolised by ‘another god’, 
and from these left-overs that he takes from her, 
the blood of the spleen is made dark and blackened. 
It is the deceptive snake, 
which seduced Eve, who is the heart, 
and caused her death.

which of them did it seduce? 
But it was that one of the left-side, 
of which it is stated: (Ecc. 10:2) *... the heart of the fool is to his left*.

At that time, 
as the soul was held tight between the legs, 
it is this that is written: (Ruth 3:7) *... and she uncovered his feet and lay down*,

which is like Jerusalem.

אבגית״ץ ביה אפיק לישראל מגלותא. 
קר״ע שט״ן 
דאיהו שמא תניינא דיומא תניינא 
ביה קרע ימא. 
ובהאי שמא אתמר יהי רקיע 
בתוך המים. 
נגדיכ״ש נגד כל עמך 
אעשה נפלאות. 
בכל שמא נטל נוקמא במצרים


For *My heart*¹² is the Name of forty-two. 
With the Name A-V-G-Y-T-Tz – He took Israel out of exile, 
with the Name Q-R-’A S-T-N 
– which is the second Name, of the second day 
– with it He split the sea, 
and of this Name it is stated: (Gen. 1:6) *... ‘Let there be a firmament, 
in the midst of the waters... ’* *
*N-G-D-Y-Kh-Sh – (Ex. 34:10) *... ‘in front of’*¹ *all your people, 
I shall do wonders...’ 
*With each Name, He took revenge upon Egypt.

that from the heart to the mouth it is not revealed.

טחול נחש. 
יותרת הכבד אשת זנונים. 
בתר דעבידת זיופא (ס״א נאופא) 
עם אלקים אחרים 
ופליגת דמא דילה דאיהי תמצית דילה 
לכל ערקין. 
שיורא קריבת לגבי טחול דאיהו בעלה כסיל. 
דלא נטיל טחול אלא תמצית (נ״א שמרים) דדמא. 
ולא יהיב ליה מדמא אחרא. 
ובגין דא אתקריאת יותרת הכבד 
בגין דלא יהיב ליה אלא שיורין.


The spleen is ‘snake’, 
the extra lobe of the liver is ‘the whoring wife’, 
after she has acted dishonestly [Var. immorally ] 
with ‘other gods’, 
and has distributed her blood, which is her concentrate, 
to all the veins, 
she offers the leftover to the spleen who is her husband, the fool. 
For the spleen takes only the concentrate [Var. dregs] of blood, 
but she does not give him of any other blood, 
and because of this she is called ‘the extra lobe of the liver’, 
because she gives him only the leftover.

וכבד איהו קטרוגא דריאה.

הוה אוקיד ללבא. 
(ס״א והוה אוקיד כל גופא נורא דלבא):


And the liver is the antagonist of the lung, 
for it raises up a fire from it towards the heart, 
and were it not that the wings of the lung blow upon it, 
it would burn up the heart, 
[Var. and the fire of the heart would burn up the whole body].

לא יפסיק 
אבל עקרב פוסק.


The ‘entrails’¹ is *livyatan*², 
corresponding to the impure fat, 
and upon it is stated:³ 
‘Even if a snake is wound around his ankle, 
he should not interrupt his prayer, 
but for a scorpion, he interrupts’.

תקיעה שברים ותרועה 
אינון תבירו דלהון. 
ועלייהו אתמר אשרי העם 
יודעי תרועה יי׳ 
באור פניך יהלכון. 
מאי פניך 
אלין תקיעה שברים ותרועה. דאינון 
תקיעה חוורו דאנפין 
שברים סומקו דאנפין. 
תרועה ירוקא דאנפין.

בזמנא דמתהפכין אנפין דישראל לירוקא 
כאתתא עוברא.


Because of this, 
the horn-blasts *te-qi’ah*, *she-varim*, and *te-ru’ah* 
are the means of their smashing, 
and of them it is stated: (Ps. 89:16) *Happy is the nation, 
those who know the te-ru’ah, Y”Y, 
they shall walk in the light of Your face*. 
What is *... Your face*? 
These are *te-qi’ah*, *she-varim*, *te-ru’ah*, which are: 
*te-qi’ah* – the white of the face, 
*she-varim* – the red of the face, 
*te-ru’ah* – the green of the face. 
And through it *te-ru’ah* Israel emerges from exile, 
when the faces of Israel are transformed to green, 
like a pregnant woman.¹

of which:

Corresponding to that:

It is not written “*to swallow Jonah*”,

The *ET* comes to include the Faithful Shepherd,

דביה אשתלים גד 
ואתעביד *גיד.


An Elder arose from behind the shade, 
he began and said: 
(Num. 11:7) *And the manna was like seed of coriander*¹ *...* *
*What is ‘seed of coriander’? 
But ‘GaD’¹ is right and left, 
composed of *Ge-mol*¹ and*Dalim*¹.² 
*... like seed of coriander...*– this is Jonah¹, 
commencing with Yod³ specifically – the white drop, 
through which *gad* is completed, 
and is made into *gyd*¹⁴.

And there is the view that says: 
(Gen. 7:2) *... seven by seven... 
*– from the aspect of *Bat Sheva*¹. 
And these are:... *one from a town*. (Jer. 3:14) 
Noah – this is Sabbath, 
in which is the rest inherited by a righteous-one. 
*Two by two...* (Gen. 7:9) – two days: 
one of New Year, and one of the Day of Judgement, 
for the second day is from doubt,² 
and one day of the Day of Atonement, 
and one day of the Festival of Weeks, 
and... *seven by seven...* (Gen. 7:2) ... are: 
the seven days of Tabernacles, and the seven days of Passover, 
for whoever observes these days is destined to be saved in the exile.]

– the right arm to receive those who return, 
and it lifts them up from their falling, and takes hold of their hands, 
and says to them: (Is. 52:2) *... arise! Sit down, O Jerusalem...*


###### Tikkunei Zohar 55a:2

בזכותא דמשה 
דאיהו מתן תורה רחמי. 
וגלי לון ספר תורה 
ויתכנשון לירושלם 
ותראה היבשה מלכות הרשעה 
ורחמי על בנוי 
וביה כנשר יעיר קנו. 
מאן קנו. 
ירושלם קנו (לשכינתא).


And on the Festival of Weeks they will emerge, 
through the merit of Moses, 
who is ‘the giving of the Torah’ – which is mercy, 
 and he reveals to them the Book of the Torah, 
and they will gather to Jerusalem, 
(Gen. 1:9) *... and the dry land will be visible* – the wicked kingdom, 
and He has mercy upon His children, 
of that: (Deut. 32:11) *Like an eagle arousing its nest*... 
Who is ‘His nest?’ 
Jerusalem is His nest [for the Shekhinah].

צריך בר נש לנטלא אתרוג בידא שמאלא.

שלימא בתיומת דילה, 
בגין ההוא דאתמר ביה 
ויעקב איש תם 
למהוי שלימה עמיה.

And therefore, 
a person should take the *etrog*¹ in the left hand. 
And it needs to be an *etrog* that is like the heart, 
complete, with its ‘*tyomet*’ 
because of him of whom is stated: 
(Gen. 25:27) *... and Jacob was a complete*¹ *man 
*– to be perfect with Him. 
And just as there is no defect in Jacob above, 
so there must be no defect in the *etrog*, 
to fulfill the verse: (Song. 4:7) *You are completely beautiful my beloved, 
there is no blemish in you*.

אתרוג דמי לצדיקייא.
